newsitem.title: USA: Fruehauf Trailer to sell axle products unit.
newsitem.headline: Fruehauf Trailer to sell axle products unit.

text.p: Fruehauf Trailer Corp on Wednesday said it agreed to sell the assets of its Delphos Axle Products unit to Holland Hitch Co for about $13 million plus an unspecified amount for working capital.

Fruehauf, which filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in October and must obtain court approval to sell any of its assets, said it would continue to consider competing written bids for its Delphos assets, pursuant to the proposed bidding procedures previously filed with the bankruptcy court.
The company makes truck trailers and trailer parts.
